description:
Configure the WooCommerce Product Catalog layout settings to optimize the store's visual presentation. You need to:

1. Set the Shop page to display BOTH categories and products.
2. Change the default product sorting to 'Sort by price (descending)'.
3. Adjust the layout to show 3 products per row.
4. Adjust the layout to show 5 rows per page.

You can access these settings via Appearance > Customize > WooCommerce > Product Catalog.
